# LaneAddOnQuantity

How many extra lanes of one type a tenant has bought.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `lane` | [`LaneType`](lane-type.md) |  |
| `quantity` | `integer` |  |

## Example

```json

  "quantity": 0
```
